name: Viridescent-Holm
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by frozen methane lakes, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Whoever controls dark crystals controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
